info.description: This is a backup management server for Postgres databases.
info.title: Backup Manager API

get.description: Get full details of a specific backup execution, including logs

post.description: Prevent a backup execution from being automatically cleaned up by pinning it
post.summary: Pin or unpin a backup execution

post.description: Trigger a restoration process from a specific backup execution

get.description: Check if the API server is up and running
Get an aggregated view of system health, storage usage, and active profiles
Get a list of all configured notification providers (e.g. Discord)

post.description: Configure a new destination for backup alerts

put.description: Update a notification provider's configuration by ID

get.description: Get a list of all configured backup profiles

post.description: Create a new backup profile with the specified configuration

put.description: Update a backup profile by its ID

delete.description: Delete a backup profile by its ID

post.description: Set a profile as the active one for scheduled backups. All other profiles will be deactivated.
post.summary: Activate a backup profile (sets as scheduled)

get.description: Get a history of all backup executions for a profile
get.summary: List executions for a specific profile

post.description: Trigger a backup execution for a specific profile now

get.description: Get a list of all configured retention policies (how many backups to keep)

post.description: Define a new policy for automatic backup cleanup

put.description: Update a retention policy's configuration by ID

get.description: Get a list of all configured storage providers (e.g. S3, Local)

post.description: Configure a new storage destination for backups

put.description: Update a storage provider's configuration by ID
